podcast.title: Co-copyright Holders of "The Lion Sleeps Tonight"
podcast.body: Believing the song to be traditional, they, along with George Weiss, copyrighted "The Lion Sleeps Tonight" in their names. "As it was believed by everyone involved that the song was a traditional one, the new song was copyrighted in the names of Wiss, Hugo and Luigi."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Production Duo for The Tokens
podcast.body: Hugo and Luigi were the production duo working with The Tokens on RCA Records, notably on "The Lion Sleeps Tonight." "But by then, the group had signed to RCA Records, and were now working with Hugo and the Ouija, the production duo, who you might remember from the episode on Shout."
